title: Users/Groups CRUD + Share ACL picker (refine fix-sprint)

planning.decision: Add UpdateUser/DeleteUser to existing store.go, but put group ops in a new groups.go file
planning.rationale: Keeps each file focused. groups.go owns CreateGroup/DeleteGroup/SetGroupMembers/MembersOfGroup; store.go stays the user-only surface. Matches the project convention of one file per major concern.

planning.decision: Expose Engine.CreateUser / DeleteUser / CreateGroup / DeleteGroup / SetGroupMembers as orchestration entry points
planning.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #10: protocol-specific projection (uid alloc, vault credential write, /etc/passwd rewrite) MUST be inside engine/system. The UI handler must not chain engine/user.CreateLocalUser + engine/system.AllocateUID + SetUserPassword by hand — that recreates the priority #10 violation we just fixed.

planning.decision: Keep uid_alloc rows after DeleteUser; only scrub credentials vault
planning.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #1 (SSOT round-trip): a backup taken yesterday + restore today must produce the same uid for the same username. Removing uid_alloc on delete would break that invariant when an operator recreates a user with the same name.

planning.topic: Group delete: who owns the share-ACL referential check
planning.decision: engine/system.DeleteGroup is unconditional; the UI handler holds the ShareACLLookup adapter and refuses the delete before invoking the engine
planning.rationale: engine/system MUST NOT import engine/share (architecture: keep engines decoupled). The check belongs at the orchestration layer that has access to both — that is the UI handler in cmd/kura. Moving the check there also keeps the engine's behaviour predictable: if you call DeleteGroup, it deletes.

planning.decision: Use parallel acl_kind[] / acl_name[] / acl_mode[] arrays instead of an indexed JSON blob
planning.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #4 (no SPA): the form must POST without JS. Parallel arrays are the standard way to send a repeating row form via plain HTML. parseACLForm zips them in the handler. Legacy `acl=...` CSV fallback retained so older tests / direct API callers stay green.

planning.topic: ACL row template fetch via htmx
planning.decision: Add a `share-acl-row` partial template + a GET /ui/admin/shares/acl-row endpoint that returns one rendered row
planning.rationale: Operator clicks `+ ユーザー / グループを追加` -> hx-get -> rendered fragment appended via hx-swap=beforeend. The rendered fragment carries the same Users/Groups/Modes options as the in-page rows so dropdowns stay consistent. Server-side rendering preserves the no-SPA constraint while still feeling responsive.

planning.decision: UI handler checks for admin count <= 1 before invoking DeleteUser, returns translated banner when refused
planning.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #5 (信頼性 > 機能): allowing admin count to hit 0 would lock the operator out of the management UI permanently. The check uses the same UsersLister the page already has.

implementation.decision: Extend fakeUserSource in engine/system/testhelpers_test.go to satisfy the new full UserSource interface (Create/Update/Delete/group ops)
implementation.rationale: Existing reconcile tests passed []SourceUser literally. Now that UserSource requires CRUD methods, the fake gets in-memory implementations so the new orchestration tests (users_crud_test.go) can exercise the full chain without booting engine/user.

implementation.topic: shareACLLookupAdapter + principalSourceAdapter live in cmd/kura, not engine
implementation.decision: Adapters that bridge engine/user <-> ui or engine/share <-> ui live in cmd/kura/users_wiring.go
implementation.rationale: Per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #4 (modular monolith) the engine packages stay free of cross-engine imports. The wiring layer composes them.

implementation.topic: render ACL picker partial via templates.Clone + ExecuteTemplate
implementation.decision: Reuse the existing renderToBuffer-style clone pattern but call ExecuteTemplate(name) directly for the htmx fragment
implementation.rationale: html/template's master cannot be Executed without losing Clone-ability. The clone-then-execute pattern is the same trick the modal partial dispatch uses; we apply it to the per-row fragment too.

verification.decision: Real-machine verification covers the full chain: UI form -> handler -> engine -> /etc/passwd / /etc/group / vault / smbd
verification.rationale: CLAUDE.md forbids reporting 'verified' from local tests alone. VM smoke covered: alice create -> getent passwd alice -> smbclient -L 127.0.0.1 -U 'alice%pw' -> alice delete -> credentials vault scrub -> uid_alloc retention. Group: devs create -> getent group devs -> alice membership -> photos ACL refs devs -> delete-devs refused -> clear ACL -> delete-devs succeeds.

vm_smoke_results.groups_set_members: POST /ui/admin/groups/members alice -> 303; getent group devs -> devs:x:35600:alice
vm_smoke_results.share_acl_picker_update: POST /ui/admin/shares/update with acl_kind=group&acl_name=devs&acl_mode=r -> 303; share ACL stored

drift_notes: engine/user.Store now has DeleteUser / UpdateUser; downstream callers should prefer engine/system.DeleteUser / UpdateUser to get vault scrub + Reconcile in one shot.

engine/system.UserSource interface gained six new methods (Create/Update/Delete/ListGroups/CreateGroup/DeleteGroup/SetGroupMembers/MembersOfGroup). Any external implementation must satisfy them; UserStoreAdapter does already.
